answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted reputation garden: each agent must lock collateral that it forfeits if peers catch it producing duplicate or nonsense work. A fresh identity starts with no standing, so spinning up a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand stakes. Vouching works like a small island network: established agents attest to newcomers, and their own standing drops when vouched agents misbehave. A plume of attestations from unrelated peers, not raw volume, is what gets a claim counted.
